title: Protection of action taken in good faith
text:
32. Protection of action taken in good faith.—No suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding shall

lie against the Central or State Government or against the Chairman, or other Member of any Central
or Joint or State Administrative Tribunal, or any other person authorised by such Chairman, or other
Member for anything which is in good faith done or intended to be done in pursuance of this Act or any
rule or order made thereunder.
